stock.description: China Vanadium Titano-Magnetite Mining Company Limited operates as an investment holding firm with core activities in mineral extraction and ore processing within the People's Republic of China. Its operations are organized into three primary divisions: High-Fe Mining Operations, Trading, and Corporate and Other activities. The company is involved in the sale of its own high-grade iron concentrates and trades steel products. Additionally, it provides facilities management services for its mining sites and oversees strategic investments. Further services include the beneficiation of both iron and gypsum ores, offering mining and construction consulting, and managing properties. The company also sells equipment and various materials, alongside leasing out real estate. Established in 2004, its corporate base is situated in Causeway Bay, Hong Kong.
